How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your new spice rack for the first time is straightforward! Here are a few simple steps to get started:
1. Test the Fit & Mount the Unit: Place the unit inside your cabinet to make sure the drawers clear any door hinges. Then, pull the drawers out and secure the base to your cabinet bottom or shelf using the included self-tapping screws. (Mounting is essential so the unit doesn't tip forward when extended!)

2. Attach the Flex-Bands: Slip one elastic Flex-Band into each set of empty grooves along the drawer sides. These flexible bands will keep your jars neatly in place while making them easy to slide in and out.
3. Load Your Spices: Place your standard jars right into the slots. If you have half-size jars, you can stack them two high per slot, as the bands will support each level.
